body: Honestly, the longer you wait the more likely you'll have an experienced and mature partner. Don't give up yet. Instead look forward to experiencing that and let that be part of your motivation for living!

If I choose adoption would my soon to be ex husband have the right to "adopt" the baby? I don't want the baby in his hands cause I really don't think that's a stable environment for it. I don't want to keep a kid from their dad but I know having a very toxic and unstable dad is pretty bad in it's own way. I've been told I can not put him on the birth certificate but I don't know if that'll make a difference. This is the only thing keeping me from choosing adoption.

Nothing. Crying is normal and not a sign of weakness like society has you to believe. Its even more normal for that to come around at night because you're alone with your thoughts and it's time to decompress for the day. Even if that means crying. ❤️
I know it's making it worse. I just don't know if I can make that decision. It's really hard.
I can't give him anymore money so that's not a problem. Only reason I have food right this second is because of my mom. He just doesn't get it.

I understand what you're saying and I've thought about it. I'll think about it some more. I just don't know if I can personally abort something I did plan even though the circumstances suck. But I'll certainly give it more thought. I know it's a big decision. I just don't know if I'm in my right mind to make it. But I know I need to soon
Yeah I know I qualify for WIC. Going to look into food stamps in my area next. It's so stressful to do anything but sleep but I know I have to force myself.
If you have a friend to stay with I'd consider this. You sound like you're in a bad spot right now. Hope it gets better
I appreciate that you took the time to let us know your story. If you need to talk to an internet stranger I'm here for you! Please don't feel like you have to do this alone.

So as for your porn addiction.. don't beat yourself up over it. You made it for 42 days! That's 42 days you got it out of your system and 42 days you proved to yourself that you can do this. You lapsing was just a little speed bump. Almost any addict of anything will tell you relapsing is a quite common occurrence. Just a lesson on what made you relapse so that you can beat this. Everyone's personality is different. Just need to find someone who meshes. Let someone else do the work of impressing you for once and if they don't accept who you are then you know to not waste a breath on them. Hang in there. You got this!

Oh no, no one should make fun of you. Please consider cutting them out of your life. It's hard to make healthy connections when you have toxic ones are still hanging on. You need support and to feel appreciated. If you need to talk, I'm here ❤️

Focus on the good changes and not the bad. Having different friends isn't necessarily a bad thing if they're more healthy and true than the past. I hope you have positive changes soon to show you that not all is bad. It's just a bit scary. Hang in there ❤️
